title: Higher-spin algebras from soft theorems I: the wedge condition
summary: In this article we use the sub$^n$-soft graviton theorems to construct the map $\Top$ from the spin-graded set of holomorphic functions on local celestial sphere patches to differential operators acting on the asymptotic data for massless particles at $\scrip$, in analogy with previous results in the literature for the sub$^n$-soft photon theorems. The result is an explicit closed-form formula. We show that the wedge subalgebras for both Yang-Mills and gravity are the natural domain on which $\Top$ becomes a representation.
